name: The Soul of the White Dragon
source:
This kinetic visual novel is not based on drama and conflict, but loaded with a deep understanding of the human and beyond and hints at transformative choices in life.

If you think dragons are a myth, you will learn otherwise in this story. Furthermore, you will learn about the elves, and discover a whole world that you didn’t know existed right under your nose.

In her search for material for an upcoming book, Luzi stumbles upon many secrets and old wisdom, signs of seemingly lost, ancient knowledge. When searching for truth, one may find love and friendship that one has been looking for, even in places abandoned many years ago, or in realms not of this world.

Based on the [url=https://www.erikistrup.dk/eip6_white_dragon_en.html]first book[/url] (of 5) in the Luzi Cane series, it gives you a unique opportunity to enjoy an incredible adventure. At the same time, you gain so-called lost or hidden knowledge, in a world that desperately tries to wake up from its long slumber but is distracted by the ‘noise’ from the same world. The dragons are awakening, not to destroy us, but to guide us in our quest for a deeper understanding of our place in creation.

[From [url=https://eriqa-queen.itch.io/the-soul-of-the-white-dragon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部无选项视觉小说并不以戏剧冲突为核心，而是蕴含对人类及超越人类之物的深刻理解，并启示那些能改变人生的选择。

如果你认为龙只存在于神话中，这个故事将改变你的看法。你还会认识精灵，发现一个就在眼前、却从未察觉其存在的世界。

为了给下一本书搜集素材，Luzi偶然触及了许多秘密与古老智慧，寻得那些看似早已失传的远古知识的踪迹。追寻真相时，人们也许会找到一直渴望的爱情与友谊，即使是在荒废多年的地方，或是不属于这个世界的领域。

本作改编自Luzi Cane系列五部小说中的[url=https://www.erikistrup.dk/eip6_white_dragon_en.html]第一部[/url]，让你有机会经历一场不可思议的冒险。与此同时，你也将在这个世界里获得那些所谓失落或隐秘的知识：世界迫切地想从漫长沉睡中醒来，却又被自身的“喧嚣”分散注意。巨龙正在苏醒，它们并非要毁灭我们，而是要引领我们，更深刻地认识自己在万物之中的位置。

[摘自[url=https://eriqa-queen.itch.io/the-soul-of-the-white-dragon]itch.io[/url]]
